name: Demet Özdemir
bio: Demet Özdemir was born in 1982 in Üsküdar, Istanbul. She is married and has one son. She has loved painting ever since she was a child. Between 2001 and 2005, she studied at Marmara University, Faculty of Fine Arts, graduating from the Department of Traditional Turkish Handicrafts. After graduation, she worked as a designer in the home textiles industry. In 2007, she went to England to study English. Upon returning, she continued working as a designer for a while. In 2021, she completed the Pedagogical Formation program at Marmara University and shifted her career toward visual arts education. Since 2021, Demet has focused on illustrating children’s books and has illustrated numerous titles. She especially loves drawing with imagination, creating art that sparks wonder for young readers.
